description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (3.50 each) capped at 19999, grants [MAG and MND +50% (25s)], [Attach Ice with Stacking], [Damage Cap +20000], [Dual Awoken Ice Mode I (Ysayle)] and [Ice Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Ice Mode I (Ysayle)
